text: In 1991 San Francisco, a vampire named Louis tells a reporter his life story. In 1791 Louisiana, grieving his pregnant wife, the young plantation owner [accepts Lestat's offer to make him a vampire|trigger|saying yes to an offer] and regrets it at once, [living on animal blood rather than kill|who_suffers|monsters who suffer] while Lestat [revels in the hunt|threat|blood drinkers]. To keep him, Lestat [turns a dying plague orphan named Claudia|wrong|harm done to children], and the two men raise her as a daughter whose mind grows old while her body stays a little girl's.
